audio/Welcome_prompt_01.mp3.verbatim: Welcome to Okwanchofapa, an easy financial transaction service. For English, press 1. For Twi, press 2.

audio/English/Audio_prompt_02.mp3.verbatim: For Telecom mobile money services, press 1. For banking services, press 2. To hear this again, press 9. To exit, press 0.

audio/English/Audio_prompt_03.mp3.verbatim: Select your network. For MTN, press 1. For Telecel, press 2. For AirtelTigo, press 3. Press 9 to hear this again. Press 0 to exit.

audio/English/Audio_prompt_04.mp3.verbatim: Select your network. For MTN, press 1. For Telecel, press 2. For AirtelTigo, press 3. Press 9 to hear this again or 0 to exit.

audio/English/Audio_prompt_05.mp3.verbatim: MTN services. To send money to another MoMo user, press 1. To pay bills, press 2. To buy airtime or bundle, press 3. To allow cash out, press 4. To check your account, press 5. Press 8 to go back or 0 to exit.

options.1: Send money to another MoMo user

audio/English/Audio_prompt_06.mp3.verbatim: Enter the 10 digit number you want to send money to followed by hash. Press 0 to exit.
audio/English/Audio_prompt_06.mp3.options: Enter a 10 digit number, or press 0 to exit

audio/English/Audio_prompt_08.mp3.verbatim: You are about to send money to Kojo Nyamebru whose phone number ends with 4567. To confirm and send the money, press 1, to cancel, press 2, to exit completely, press 0.

audio/English/Audio_prompt_09.mp3.verbatim: Enter the cedi amount you want to send to Kwami Nyamebre followed by hash. Use star for pesewas.
audio/English/Audio_prompt_09.mp3.options: Use * for decimal point (pesewas) and # to submit

audio/English/Audio_prompt_10.mp3.verbatim: You are about to send 500 Ghana Cedis to Kwame Namebo. To confirm and send, press 1. To cancel, press 2.
audio/English/Audio_prompt_10.mp3.options: Press 1 to confirm and send, press 2 to cancel

audio/English/Audio_prompt_11.mp3.verbatim: Confirmed. Now, please check your phone's screen and enter your Momo PIN accurately. Thank you for using Okwanso Papa. Goodbye.

audio/English/Audio_prompt_12.mp3.verbatim: Congratulations, you have successfully sent 500 Ghana Cedis to Kwame Nyamebr3. Your transaction was completed on 17th September 2026 at 5:00 PM. Your reference number is OKP847291. Your transaction details have also been sent to you. Would you like to do anything else?

audio/Twi/Audio_prompt_twi_02.mp3.verbatim: Afei select-i wo network. Sɛ MTN a, mia baako. Sɛ Telecel a, mia mmienu. Sɛ AirtelTigo a, mia mmiɛnsa. Mia nnan na tie wei biom. Mia zero na si ha.
audio/Twi/Audio_prompt_twi_02.mp3.options: 1 for MTN, 2 for Telecel, 3 for AirtelTigo, 4 to repeat, 0 to end/exit

audio/Twi/Audio_prompt_twi_03.mp3.verbatim: Sɛ wonpɛ sɛ wo si ka ko mobio yi simu 1, mi abako. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotie abɛ osɛ, mi amienu. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wo tɔ airtime anaa bundle, mi amiesa. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woala woka shouter, mi afour. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wochecki wo account no a, mi afive. Mia eight na kowɛchi. Mia zero nɛsi ha.

audio/Twi/Audio_prompt_twi_04.mp3.verbatim: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosend sika kɔ ma momo user, mia 1. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotia bɔɔsa, mia 2. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotɔ airtime anaa bundle, mia 3. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woallow cash out, mia 4. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wochecki wo account no, mia 5. Mia 8 na kɔ back. Mia 0 next.
audio/Twi/Audio_prompt_twi_04.mp3.options: 1: send money to momo user, 2: withdraw cash, 3: buy airtime or bundle, 4: allow cash out, 5: check account, 8: go back, 0: next

audio/Twi/Audio_prompt_twi_05.mp3.verbatim: Afei mobɔ namba no a wopɛ sɛ wosend sika toso no, wie a fa ash ɛka ho. Mia zero na esi ha.
audio/Twi/Audio_prompt_twi_05.mp3.options: [phone number]# to specify recipient, 0 to go back
